title: US 50 EB over Tanners Creek | 2014 reconstruction design
source_note: Primary: 149-page existing-plans bundle. This model uses the 2014 B-29709 Bulb-T reconstruction sheets (PDF pp.103-149), not the earlier concrete-arch/steel-era sheets. 2026 overlay and revision are references only.
assumptions: Exterior visualization reconstruction, not an as-built survey, load rating or validated FEM mesh.
No internal reinforcement, prestressing strands, embedded studs, weld beads or fabrication holes. Material colors are visualization choices.
Source pages mix historical removals and proposed work. Only the explicitly named design state is modeled; the separately stored later references do not alter that state.
Buried foundations are hidden by default. Unknown driven pile lengths, terrain and approach-road terminal systems are omitted.
Bearing contact checks verify constructed geometric attachment only; they do not establish surveyed bearing elevations or fabrication tolerances.
Seven beam lines have asymmetric overhangs (4 ft 1 in / 3 ft 1 in). The grade crown is offset 4 ft 7 in from the structure centerline.
No 2026 thin overlay or field patching is represented. Vertical geometry is a fitted grade envelope, not fabrication camber.

detail_coverage.detail: 35 individual 66 in Bulb-T beams, asymmetric 72 ft 2 in deck, 13 ft 8 in sidewalk and 20-degree skew. The adjacent westbound bridge is excluded.
Six bents, four-column retained/widened envelopes, deep central bents with tie beams and paired interior bearing rows. Local seats, haunches and retained/widened seams are simplified.
X frames, highway FT concrete barrier and distinct sidewalk PS-1 rail. Frame sections and PS-1 post details are approximate.
Both 20 ft 6 in approach envelopes; transitions and the southeast sidewalk ramp remain incomplete.
End-bent wings, complete support diaphragms, drainage, lighting, local sidewalk ramps, concrete surface recesses and shop camber remain unresolved.
